endpoint: SCOUT-HCM change in provoked Valsalva left ventricular outflow tract gradient through week 28.
effect_size: Adjusted treatment difference −48.0 mmHg (95% CI −67.7 to −28.3), mavacamten versus placebo.
statistical_significance: Primary comparison p<0.0001.
safety: FDA label carries a boxed warning for heart failure from systolic dysfunction and requires monitoring. The pivotal study was small.
rationale: The controlled pediatric study showed a substantial reduction in obstruction. The established systolic dysfunction risk remains clinically important. The approval was known when this judgment was recorded.
evidence_gaps: ["Longer follow-up and precision for uncommon pediatric harms.", "Numerical confidence is not calibrated."]
confidence_basis: Qualitative judgment; no calibrated percentage available
